response.sql: SELECT r.raceId, r.name, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId WHERE res.positionOrder >= 12 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name ORDER BY (avg_laps IS NULL) ASC, avg_laps DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: laps is stored as TEXT, so it is cast to a number before averaging. Missing values (NULL) are ignored by AVG. Empty strings, if any, would cast to 0 rather than being ignored.
The 10-row limit applies after ordering by average laps descending, with races whose average is NULL placed last. Ties are broken arbitrarily.
